# Dezign2App

> Visual software architecture compiler turning system topologies into production-ready full-stack monorepos with zero token tax on boilerplate.

Dezign2App transforms visual system design graphs (services, PostgreSQL/SQLite databases, Kafka event streams, Redis cache, and auth boundaries) into clean, standard Turborepo monorepos with Next.js 16, Express/FastAPI microservices, Drizzle ORM schemas, and Docker Compose orchestration. It uses deterministic Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) compilation on the local CPU for 100% predictable scaffolding, reserving AI strictly for bespoke business logic.

## The "Algorithm + AI" Paradigm (Why It Beats Vibe Coding)
Dezign2App divides full-stack software generation into two complementary layers:
1. **Deterministic Algorithms (The 70% Predictable Architecture)**:
   - Compiles higher-level system topology, architecture scaffolding, and standard recurring patterns.
   - Generates inter-communication contracts between servers, database schema imports, Drizzle migrations, Redis cache wiring, Kafka/messaging configs, Docker network bridges, and Better Auth RBAC guards.
   - **Cost & Reliability**: Compiles in <800ms on local CPU with **0 hallucinations** and **$0 token burn**.
2. **AI-Generated Code (The 30% Custom Domain Logic)**:
   - Dedicated solely to unpredictable code blocks, custom controller algorithms, proprietary business logic, and bespoke UI workflows.
   - **Massive Token & Cost Reduction**: You never waste expensive, slow cloud reasoning models generating repetitive boilerplate. Fast, cost-efficient models write only the custom code blocks, which are locked to verified architectural contracts.
   - **Eliminates Code Review Fatigue**: Removes the burden of reading and auditing thousands of lines of messy AI-generated boilerplate. Developers only review the small, isolated pieces of custom logic that actually matter.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deterministic Monorepo Compiler**: Compiles architecture topology graphs into fully configured Turborepo monorepos in <800ms on local CPU with zero hallucinations and $0 token cost.
- **Interactive Data Flow Simulation**: Visually track and simulate how requests, payloads, Kafka event streams, and database transactions flow through the distributed topology before compiling.
- **Dedicated Testing Tab for Unit Tests**: In-canvas testing suite to author, execute, and inspect unit tests, endpoint contract validations, and state mutations in real time.
- **dpm (Dezign Package Manager)**: The visual abstraction layer for npm. Compose verified visual contracts (`@dpm/*`) and swap frameworks (Express to FastAPI, Postgres to SQLite) with one click.
- **Non-Destructive AST Sync**: Cleanly separates generated infrastructure contracts (schemas, wire protocols, shared types) from user business logic (controllers, routes, UI). Syncs do not overwrite custom code.
- **Offline Desktop Studio**: Native Electron 34 desktop application with embedded PostgreSQL, Redis, and SQLite runners, plus a native PTY terminal for 100% offline development.
- **100% Code Ownership**: Standard TypeScript monorepo with zero proprietary runtime SDKs and zero vendor lock-in.

## dpm — Dezign Package Manager
Just as TypeScript brought static typing to JavaScript via DefinitelyTyped (`@types/*`), **dpm** brings visual architecture contracts, syntax-free composition, and deterministic Agentic development to npm packages:
- **Visual Packages**: Maps packages like `@dpm/express`, `@dpm/stripe`, `@dpm/prisma`, `@dpm/langgraph`, and `@dpm/auth` into draggable nodes with verified typed I/O ports.
- **Framework & DB Swapping**: Change backend engines (Express to FastAPI) or databases (PostgreSQL to SQLite) without manual rewrites; AST compilers rewrite configuration and bridges automatically.
- **dpm Specification & RFC**: https://www.dezign2app.com/dpm

## Default Generated Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Actions, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Backend: Typed Express or Python FastAPI microservices with OpenAPI contract generation
- Database & ORM: PostgreSQL / SQLite with Drizzle ORM schemas and migration scripts
- Event Streaming & Caching: Apache Kafka topologies & Redis pub/sub
- Authentication: Better Auth with RBAC role guards and session verification
- Orchestration: Turborepo, pnpm workspaces, and Docker Compose

## Pricing
- **Beta Access**: $20 / month (unlimited monorepo code generation, local CPU compilation, full source code ownership, zero token limits on scaffolding).
